answer: Because the relic measurement is bound to the comet signature, the wharf audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. A farm that substitutes a trivial script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 211 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
